annotations.title: Set the action at the threshold

description: What happens to an hourly server when the account balance runs short and no automatic reload brings it back: HIBERNATE (hibernated at its threshold, hourly hibernation fee, restarted as soon as the balance is back) or DELETE (no hibernation fee, kept running while the balance pays its next hour, then stopped). Machines that cannot be hibernated (spot) only accept DELETE. An hourly server whose action is HIBERNATE is never deleted automatically while hibernated, nor its data. When the balance covers only about 24 hours of what the account spends per hour, a first notice is sent while the servers still run, then two more about 24 hours and 1 hour before the credit runs out. Once the credit is exhausted (the balance no longer pays the next hour of the account's servers), the card on file is charged once per exhaustion of the account's credit (not per server) to keep its hibernated servers active: the CA$25 minimum, or the amount of the automatic reload when it is on, with a notice after each charge, as long as the server exists and its action is not DELETE (Close); turning the automatic reload off does not stop these charges, only Close or deleting the server does. With no card on file or a declined card, nothing is charged and the server stays hibernated (never deleted), with a notice. Only a server whose action is DELETE (chosen by the user, or a machine that cannot be hibernated) is deleted with its data, once it is stopped or hibernated for lack of credit, or hibernated by the user for at least 72 hours, the credit is exhausted, after the three notices and at least 24 hours after the first. Adding credits cancels the deletion. Spends nothing. (permission: servers:update) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]
